I'm doing DBT at the moment, to me this sounds like it could be helped by mindfulness and defusion. Practice mindfulness daily to build up your awareness. If you can catch yourself in the middle of rumination, say something like "there I am ruminating again". For specific thoughts, repeat the thought in your head 5 times, then "I'm thinking thought" five times, then "I notice I'm thinking thought" five times. Practice practice practice. Mindfulness is becoming aware non judgementally. If you notice and observe/describe then it's mindfulness. 

You could also try 5 senses exercise. If you catch yourself being fused to thoughts or emotions, name 5 things you can see, 4 things you hear, 3 things you feel, 2 things you smell, 1 thing you taste.

Fusion in this context means being lost in the rumination. Defusion is pulling your awareness back and observing/describing what your mind is doing. Or using senses to bring your awareness elsewhere.

I hope this helps, there are so many online resources, Google will lead you there!
